aria: Animated recap of the Lakers' 109 to 94 home win over the Jazz: Jake LaRavia's 3-pointer with 3:35 left that made it 102 to 88, quarter-by-quarter scoring, Luka Dončić's 28 points and 8 assists, the top scorers, how the Lakers won, and the next game.

notes: Box score from the Lakers' 109–94 home win over the Utah Jazz on Nov 23, 2026, from the Covers game page; all 109 Lakers points and all 94 Utah points add up from the player lines, as do the shooting totals (35 of 81, 12 of 42 from three, 27 of 35 FT for the Lakers; 37 of 89, 6 of 32, 14 of 21 for Utah), rebounds (45–46), assists (23–19), steals (10–9), blocks (6–4), fast-break points (26–9) and the biggest leads (Lakers 17, Utah 3). The quarter scores (30–23–25–31 to 20–22–35–17) add up to both totals and are also on Sports Preferred; 53–42 at the half is in the LA Times and 78–77 after three in Ball Exclusives. Player lines used here also match Fadeaway World (Dončić 28 with 8 assists, 8 of 24, 3 of 14 from three, 9 of 10 FT; LaRavia 15 and 10; Thybulle 14 on 6 of 9 with 2 blocks; Sexton 12 off the bench; Kessler 10 and 12; Filipowski 21 and 12; Bailey 18), and KNBR and Sports Preferred have the same points. Fast-break points (26–9), points off turnovers (20–7) and threes (12 of 42 to 6 of 32) are also in Fadeaway World. Dončić's 14 first-quarter points are in KNBR and Sports Preferred. Records and ranks are from the site's standings after Monday's games.

The Lakers have won 11 of their last 12 (LA Times; KNBR) and got payback for Utah's 109–97 win last Wednesday (KNBR). Utah opened the third on a 15–3 run and led 74–71 on Kyle Filipowski's four straight points with 1:27 left in the quarter (KNBR); Collin Sexton scored the last five points of a 9–0 run to open the fourth for an 87–77 lead (KNBR). Austin Reaves (left heel bruise) missed a fifth straight game (LA Times; KNBR). Next: the Lakers visit the Spurs on Friday in the NBA Cup group finale (LA Times).

The play of the game is an original illustration of Jake LaRavia's 3-pointer with 3:35 left that made it 102–88: KNBR: Filipowski's inside basket "pulled Utah within 99-88" with 3:54 left, and LaRavia "answered with a 3-pointer 19 seconds later to give the Lakers a 102-88 lead with 3:35 remaining"; Sports Preferred also singles out the shot. The board's Lakers +11 to +14 is 99–88 to 102–88. The shot's spot and the pass aren't described, so it is drawn as the template's plain pull-up from beyond the arc. The figures are stylized and not traced from footage, and the spacing is not to scale.

The music is an original beat made for this page. No existing recordings or melodies are used. This is an unofficial fan recap, not affiliated with the Los Angeles Lakers or the NBA, which is why it carries a plain basketball mark and the team's colors but not the team's logo.

The shooter in the play of the game is drawn to LaRavia's listed 6-foot-7 and 235 pounds (Wikipedia; Basketball-Reference), with arms at the default length because neither reports a wingspan, in the Lakers' home kit with No. 12 (Wikipedia) and the default darker skin tone, since he has no approved look yet. It is an original figure with a featureless face, not a portrait or a trace of footage.
